note: Each coverage row names the rule that DISCHARGES the criterion, not merely a rule in the same area - the Major finding D2's review raised, avoided here by writing the rule where one was missing rather than re-pointing a mapping. Two ID facts, both verified against .claude/tools/aidlc-sensor-traceability.ts rather than inferred. (1) The AC pattern is \bAC\d+\.\d+\.\d+\b, which has no word boundary before a trailing letter, so AC1.14.1a and AC1.14.2a are invisible to it; AC1.14.1a is LIVE and is covered by BR1.7, mapped under its base form AC1.14.1 alongside BR1.6. (2) AC1.14.2a is superseded - it assigned D1 a minimum ledger, and the story map established no ledger table existed for D1 to write to, so US1.14 is wholly D3's; it is not in upstream_ids because no live criterion bears that ID. BR ids are unit-scoped, as in D1 and D2, so D3 numbers from BR1.1. The reverse array explains ten D3 rules that implement a system-wide constraint, a project rule or an upstream FR with no acceptance criterion of its own.

reverse.target: FR5.2 - periods are calendar months as YYYY-MM and no calendar logic enters app.money. A representation and module-boundary constraint; no acceptance criterion names the period key format
An ASSUMPTION this unit records rather than a criterion it discharges. Batch.fee_due_day is nullable and nothing upstream says what a null means. Flagged for the human in functional-spec.md
ADR-002 - a carry is written as a pair in one transaction. The arithmetic half is already enforced in app/money/_ledger.py; this rule binds the PERSISTED rows, which no criterion addresses
ADR-002 - a carry never exceeds what the origin owes. Enforced by carry_forward() when origin_balance is supplied; the rule is that D3 always supplies it
ADR-002 - amounts are non-negative and the sign lives in the kind. A table-level CHECK, because the value type cannot defend against a row inserted by a migration or repair script
ADR-002 - credit belongs to the enrollment, not to a cycle. A structural consequence of the ledger design; AC6.3.8 depends on it but does not state it

FR5.7, TC-7, D-20 - money crosses the API as a JSON string. A system-wide invariant enforced mechanically; AC5.1.5 was deliberately REMOVED from US5.1 and promoted to system-wide invariants for exactly this reason
TC-15, D-43 - Money.format emits Latin digits, reconciling the server with the rule core/format/Numerals.kt already settled on the client. A cross-surface consistency rule with no criterion
FR10.3, FR10.4 - a reminder is an event and the reminded state is the latest per (enrollment, period). FR10.x carries no acceptance criterion in either record
FR10.2 - delivery never fails the triggering operation and a failed send is recorded. The project's stated exception to no-silent-failures; no criterion states it
